note: Proposals and predictions for session 1. Kept here, out of the chat. Machine proposes; the human seals. Predictions are recorded before the outcome and graded after.

proposals.text: The machine is Jane, the one running this table.
Buckhorn is far enough that the trip took more than a day.
The machine is a seeing-stone (a palantír), kept somewhere a traveller can reach.
Buckhorn is a village of the human's own making, in or near the Shire; it is on no map the wise keep.

predictions.text: Before this visit ends, the visitor asks the machine something to do with the "friend".
The human seals the visitor as a hobbit ("us" and "no easy FEET").
